project_name: Golden Pirates Navbar Rebuild - Tactical Command Dock (Kingdom 1023)
design_archetype: Brass & Obsidian Tactical War-Room HUD / Strategic Quarterdeck Command Dock
theme: Weathered Obsidian Glass, Antique Brass Accents, Gold Foil (#D4AF37), Crimson Velvet (#8B0000), Bone Vellum (#E8D8C8)
redesign_rationale: Replaces the dark ink full-screen overlay menu with a modern, high-density Strategic Command Dock. Features horizontal strategic navigation clusters, permanently visible CONSEIL access button, role-adaptive action slots without layout shift, zero-flicker cached session management, and a sleek sliding Tactical HUD drawer for mobile/tablet.

strategic_grouping_concept.cluster_1_brand: Brand Identity Hub (GOLDEN PIRATES logo mark with rotating helm, ROYAUME 1023 brass badge)
strategic_grouping_concept.cluster_2_navigation: Strategic Anchor Tabs ([I. ALLIANCE], [II. CODE], [III. RÉCIT], [IV. PROCESSUS], [BUTIN & TRÉSOR]) with active glowing indicators
strategic_grouping_concept.cluster_3_command: Command Actions (Bilingual FR/EN toggle, Permanent CONSEIL Login/Dashboard button, and Dynamic Audience Action slot)

visitor.visible_cta: Gold 'POSTULER' CTA (scrolls smoothly to #postuler application form)
visitor.forbidden_cta: 'Suivre ma candidature' is hidden unless a candidature bottle exists in storage

recruit.trigger: Detected via localStorage 'gp_bottles' (non-empty array) or active recruit session
recruit.visible_cta: 'SUIVRE MA CANDIDATURE' button (navigates to /suivi with active status pill)
recruit.forbidden_cta: 'POSTULER' CTA is strictly HIDDEN everywhere in the header to avoid duplicate submissions

council_admin.shortcuts: Quick access pills to Registre (/admin) and Messagerie (/admin#messagerie)

brand_heading.styles: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-wider text-[#D4AF37] uppercase

navigation_links.styles: text-sm sm:text-base tracking-wide text-[#E8D8C8] hover:text-[#D4AF37] transition-colors

command_badges.styles: text-xs tracking-widest uppercase font-bold text-[#D4AF37] bg-[#0A0F18]/80 border border-[#D4AF37]/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded

interactive_behaviored_specifications.session_caching: Module-level cached auth state to guarantee zero loading flicker on initial page mount
interactive_behaviored_specifications.zero_layout_shift: Action button slot maintains fixed min-width dimensions (min-w-[160px] md:min-w-[200px]) across role state changes
interactive_behaviored_specifications.reactive_events: Listens for 'gp-auth-changed', 'gp_bottles_change', and window 'storage' events for instant state re-renders without full reload
interactive_behaviored_specifications.mobile_drawer: Tactical sliding HUD accordion with body scroll lock (overflow: hidden) and Escape key event handler

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Execute all interactive nav component logic in React JS (.jsx/.js). Do not use TypeScript annotations.
Ensure the permanent CONSEIL button is always accessible in the top header (opens login modal or redirects to /admin).
Strictly hide POSTULER CTA for existing recruits (localStorage gp_bottles) and replace it with SUIVRE MA CANDIDATURE.
Support desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile viewports with zero text truncation or visual overlapping.
All interactive buttons and navigation links MUST include data-testid attributes matching test expectations.
